d: Idamant, Ilia, Trojans prisoners, men, and Cretans women The chains rise up to the prisoners, who show gratitude.
Beaches of the sea still agitated surrounded by cliffs. Broken ships on the shore
Port of Sidon with Bastimenli along the beaches Elettra, Argivi troops, Cretesi, and de' marinari
Idomeneus, Idamant, Electra. Following the king

Great square embellished with statues before the palace, of which on one side the frontispiece Arrives Idomeneus accompanied by Arbace, and by the royal sequel; the escorted king of Arbace sits on the throne destined for public audiences; Great Priest, and quantity of people.

Outside view of the magnificent temple of Neptune with a vast atrium that surrounds it, on the side of which it shakes at a far sea beach. The atrium and the galleries of the temple are filled with a multitude of people, the Priests prepare the things belonging to the sacrifice. Idomeneus arrives accompanied by numerous and sumptuous followers.
Idante in white robe, garland of flowers on his head, surrounded by guards, and priests; multitude of the people, and these.
